title_zh: 区分课堂虚构案例中的大会和立法机构

scenario.label_zh: 核对虚构公民教育案例中的机构关系
scenario.goal_zh: 依据案例说明区分选民、政党大会和立法机构，并约定重画职责图示

context_zh: 学生使用虚构共和国的公民教育案例练习展示；对话不描述现实国家的现行法律。
author: author-phase07-a

sentences.speaker: Luca
sentences.text: In our fictional republic, is the party convention the same thing as the congress?

sentences.speaker: Esme
sentences.text: No. Look at the case notes: the party meets at a convention to choose its candidate. The congress is the national law-making body.

sentences.speaker: Luca
sentences.text: So every citizen who votes in an election is also a member of the congress?

sentences.speaker: Esme
sentences.text: Not in this case. Voters choose representatives; the representatives hold the seats.

sentences.speaker: Luca
sentences.text: I see. My diagram mixes the voters, the party meeting, and the elected body together.

sentences.speaker: Esme
sentences.text: Give them separate boxes and label what each does.

sentences.speaker: Luca
sentences.text: I'll redraw it that way and use the case notes rather than guessing from the names.
